svg.title: 4K Hyprland frame captured on NVIDIA: wallpaper, bar and GPU application verified; backend 4 of 8 stages; desktop product 0 of 4 acceptance gates complete
svg.desc: Two fresh UWSM-managed PAM/logind guests pass 4K wallpaper, bar and GPU application captures, five GPU application cycles, complete terminal reclamation and real guest keyboard/tablet discovery. Typed input and pointer delivery from the Windows window remain unverified. Earlier failures remain retained; long-run stability is open. Four backend stages are demonstrated; stages five and six are in progress. No desktop product gate is complete: normal first-boot/launcher/input, continuous multi-window display, reliability, recovery and performance remain open. Counts are checklists, not effort percentages. Updated October 20, 2026.

g.text: 4K Hyprland frame captured · NVIDIA GPU · 3/3 scene elements
UWSM + GPU app cycles pass twice · Guest keyboard/tablet discovered
Next: Windows-window input + sustained multi-window display · Client: 1280×720
Green: verified · Amber: in progress · Gray: pending · Updated 2026-10-20
Checklist counts do not measure engineering effort or product readiness.
